name: Kasubi Tombs
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and the burial grounds of the Buganda kings. The site showcases traditional architecture and cultural heritage.

name: Lake Victoria
description: Africa's largest lake and a major tourist attraction offering fishing, boat cruises, and scenic waterfront views.

name: Uganda Museum
description: The oldest museum in East Africa featuring exhibits on Uganda's history, culture, archaeology, and natural heritage.

name: Baháʼí Temple
description: The only Baháʼí House of Worship in Africa, surrounded by beautiful gardens and offering panoramic views of Kampala.

name: Gaddafi National Mosque
description: One of Uganda's largest mosques, providing stunning views of Kampala from its minaret and showcasing impressive architecture.

name: Wandegeya Market
description: A vibrant local market where visitors can experience fresh produce, local foods, and everyday Kampala commerce.

name: Entebbe Botanical Gardens
description: A peaceful nature destination with diverse plant species, birdlife, and scenic views along the shores of Lake Victoria.

name: Nakasero Market
description: A bustling market known for fresh fruits, vegetables, spices, and a rich display of local commerce and culture.
